---
title: "Popularity of the Name Angel Over Time"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

names_df <- read_csv("ssa-baby-names.csv")

famous_angels <- tibble(
  year = c(1942, 1988, 2002),
  y_pos = c(5000, 8000, 11000),
  label = c(
    "Angel Cordero Jr.\n(b. 1942)",
    "Ángel Di María\n(b. 1988)",
    "Angel Reese\n(b. 2002)"
  )
)

names_df |>
  filter(name == "Angel") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, color = sex)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    data = famous_angels,
    aes(xintercept = year),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = famous_angels,
    aes(x = year, y = y_pos, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.05,
    size = 3.2,
    color = "gray20"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Babies Named 'Angel' in the U.S. (1880–2025)",
    subtitle = "Annual count by sex with birth years of famous people named Angel",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: Social Security Administration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Famous People Named Angel

- **Angel Cordero Jr. (born 1942):** Hall of Fame thoroughbred horse racing jockey and three-time Kentucky Derby winner.
- **Angel McCoughtry (born 1986):** Two-time Olympic gold medalist and WNBA basketball star.
- **Ángel Di María (born 1988):** Argentine professional soccer player and 2022 FIFA World Cup champion.
- **Angel Reese (born 2002):** NCAA champion and WNBA basketball star.
